description: This PHP source file implements the event viewer page for the TestLink open source testing management system. It handles displaying, filtering, and deleting event logs with functions to initialize parameters, check user rights, build the GUI, process filters, and construct an HTML table of events.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for rendering extended HTML tables used to display event logs

classes.name: tlLogger
classes.description: A class defining log level constants such as AUDIT, ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG, and L18N

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing users, with methods to retrieve user information

classes.name: tlInputParameter
classes.description: Constants defining input parameter types such as STRING_N, INT_N, ARRAY_INT

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A class for templating and rendering the Smarty templates

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves request arguments for the page

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has rights to view or manage events

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with user rights, filters, and event data

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Creates filter objects based on user input, including date ranges and user selections

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table object to display a list of events with sorting and grouping features
